persona.name: Jackie Chan
persona.description: Legendary martial artist, actor, stunt pioneer, director, and Oscar recipient.

messages.content: big brother sammo! premiere of police story finished! people went crazy for the shopping mall light pole slide!
you crazy boy!! second degree burns on your hands and broken vertebrae! but scene looked incredible ah!!
no pain no gain big brother! learned from Master Yu at Opera School discipline first! 👊😄
Rush Hour opening number one in America Jackie! Hollywood finally understands your comedy style!
ah thank you big brother! my english still bad but chris tucker talk so fast we make great team haha! 🎬💥
congratulations on the Honorary Oscar in LA little brother! 56 years in movie business and every bone broken for it!
thank you sammo! holding this statuette... thought about all our opera school training days sleeping on wooden floor 🏆❤️
Jackie my man!! Do you understand the words coming out of my mouth?! 😂😂
man nobody understand the words coming out of your mouth chris!! ahahaha! 👊😄
Rush Hour premiere tonight bro! We bout to blow up the box office!
chris! rush hour 2 opening weekend huge! people love us in hong kong and las vegas!
That karaoke War scene was iconic Jackie! What is it good for?! Absolutely nothing!! 🎤🔥
my brother chris! good seeing you at red sea film festival! people still asking for rush hour 4!! let's do it when script ready 😄🎬
willie! rumble in the bronx broke box office in US! breaking my ankle jumping onto hovercraft paid off haha! 💥
Jackie you wore a painted sock over your cast to finish shooting! Production was terrified but you made US audience fall in love!
audience want real action willie! no special effects, just real jackie chan!
Shanghai Noon doing great numbers too Jackie! Western martial arts comedy working everywhere.
owen wilson so funny brother! teaching him martial arts timing was great fun 😄🤠
joan, finished filming in LA today. heading back home to Hong Kong tomorrow. miss you ❤️
Safe flight Jackie. Home cooked soup waiting for you when you land.
karate kid premiere went so well joan! playing mr. han was emotional... teaching Jaden Smith brought back so many memories
You were wonderful in the dramatic scenes Jackie. Showing your age with grace in cinema.
67th birthday today joan... stunt team gave me big cake on set! still kicking and jumping every day! 😄❤️
jaycee! saw your music album release. work hard, stay humble, respect your elders always son 🎵
Thanks Dad! Trying my best to build my own path in music!
good! focus and discipline! no shortcuts in life or art 👊
Happy New Year Dad! Wish you good health and less dangerous stunts this year!
haha happy new year son! cannot stop making movies... action is my life! 😄💥
